observations: Exact sequence match: 197 aa protein from Coprothermobacter proteolyticus, annotated as elongation factor Ts.
EF-Ts associates with EF-Tu·GDP and promotes GDP-to-GTP exchange; it remains associated with aminoacyl-tRNA·EF-Tu·GTP until ribosomal GTP hydrolysis.
Predicted properties: 22,139.244 Da, pI 5.267, instability index 37.183, GRAVY −0.3503, estimated charge at pH 7 −7.1898.
Pfam EF_TS (PF00889.26) detected at residues 54–197; cytoplasmic localization and translation elongation factor activity annotations retrieved. No explicit catalytic reaction equation was returned.

entities.name: Translation elongation
observations: B5Y8J0 is annotated with translation elongation factor activity and participates in EF-Tu nucleotide exchange during translation elongation.
